name: Short Cut Shrimp Flatbread with Guacamole, Tomato & Lime

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Arrange flatbreads on a baking sheet pan and place in the preheated oven. Bake, flipping halfway through, until golden and slightly crispy, 5-6 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry tomatoes and lime. Halve tomatoes; cut lime into wedges. Set both aside for serving.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (12 oz) pkg cherry tomatoes
½ lime

instructions.primary_message: Place shrimp in a colander and run under cold water until thawed, 1-2 minutes. Place on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 8 oz cooked shrimp, peeled, tail off

instructions.primary_message: Spread guacamole evenly over each flatbread. Top with tomatoes and shrimp, then season with salt and pepper to taste. Squeeze lime over top and enjoy!
